description_en: Retrieves short URLs for card SMS messages
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi get-card-sms-link --card-template-code CARD_SMS_0000 --sign-name-json '阿里云_,_阿里云2' --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetCardSmsLink

parameters.help_en: The code of the card SMS template. Select an approved card SMS template code on the Card SMS > Template Management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/card) page in the console
parameters.help_zh: 卡片短信模板Code。请在控制台卡片短信>模板管理 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/card)页面选择已通过审核的卡片短信模板Code
parameters.name: card_template_code

parameters.help_en: The external serial number extension field
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en:
The phone numbers, user IDs, or internal system identifiers.

A maximum of 10,000 phone numbers are supported.
You can also use custom identifiers with a maximum length of 60 characters.
For OPPO templates, a maximum of 10 numbers can be submitted at a time
parameters.help_zh:
手机号码、用户ID或系统内部标识。

最多支持1万个手机号码。
用户也可自定义标识，长度不超过60个字符。
OPPO厂商的模板一次最多申请10个
parameters.name: phone_number_json

parameters.help_en:
The SMS signature names.
View the signature names in the Signature Name column on the China Mainland Messages > Signature Management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign) tab in the console. You can also call the QuerySmsSignList (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sms/developer-reference/api-dysmsapi-2017-05-25-querysmssignlist) operation to query SMS signature names.

The signatures must be added and approved. The number of signatures must be the same as the number of phone numbers, and they must correspond one-to-one
parameters.help_zh:
短信签名名称。
请在控制台国内消息>签名管理 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign)页签下签名名称一列查看。也可通过QuerySmsSignList (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/sms/developer-reference/api-dysmsapi-2017-05-25-querysmssignlist?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-44282.d_0)接口查看的短信签名名称。

必须是已添加、并通过审核的短信签名；且短信签名的个数必须与手机号码的个数相同、内容一一对应
parameters.name: sign_name_json

parameters.help_en: The dynamic parameters of the card SMS template
parameters.name: card_template_param_json

parameters.help_en:
The encoding type of the card SMS short URL. Valid values:
1: mass sending.
2: personalized
parameters.help_zh:
卡片短信短链编码类型。取值：
1：群发。
2：个性化
parameters.name: card_code_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the card SMS short URL. Valid values:
1: standard short code generation.
2: custom short code generation.

If CardLinkType is not specified, the default value is standard short code generation. To generate custom short codes, contact Alibaba Cloud operations personnel for registration
parameters.help_zh:
卡片短信短链类型。取值：
1：标准生成短码。
2：自定义生成短码。

CardLinkType不填时，默认为标准生成短码。如需生成自定义短码，请联系阿里运营人员进行报备
parameters.name: card_link_type

parameters.help_en:
The short URL domain name assigned to the sending account, which must be registered in advance.

If CardLinkType is set to 2, the Domain parameter is required.
If the Domain parameter is not specified, the system default domain name is used. The maximum length is 100 characters
parameters.help_zh:
发送账号分配的短链域名，需要提前报备。

当CardLinkType为2时，Domain参数必填。
当Domain参数不填时，则使用系统默认域名。长度不超过100个字符
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The custom short code defined by the customer. The value is a 4 to 8 character string consisting of digits or letters.

This parameter is required when the generation type is custom short code generation
parameters.help_zh:
客户自定义短码。长度为4~8位的数字或字母。

当生成类型为自定义生成短码时必填
parameters.name: custom_short_code_json

Code.description_en:
The request status code. Valid values:
OK: The request was successful.
For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。取值：
OK：代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）

CardPhoneNumbers.description_en: The phone numbers that support card SMS
CardPhoneNumbers.description_zh: 支持卡片短信的手机号码

CardSignNames.description_en: The SMS signatures used to apply for card SMS short URLs. When sending messages, the signatures, recipient numbers, and card SMS short URLs must correspond one-to-one
CardSignNames.description_zh: 用于申请卡片短信短链的短信签名，在发送时签名、接收号码、卡片短信短链要一一对应

CardTmpState.description_en:
The review status of the card SMS template. Valid values:
0: Under review.
1: Approved.
2: Rejected.

If the template is not approved, the SMS falls back to the standard process
CardTmpState.description_zh:
卡片短信模板审核状态。取值：
0：审核中。
1：审核通过。
2：审核不通过。

未审核通过的短信走回落流程

NotMediaMobiles.description_en: The phone numbers that do not support card SMS
NotMediaMobiles.description_zh: 不支持卡片短信的手机号

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
